title: Match Group CEO Spencer Rascoff says growing women's share on Tinder is his "primary focus" to stem user declines; Sensor Tower says 75% of Tinder users are men (Kieran Smith/Financial Times)
summary: Kieran Smith / Financial Times: Match Group CEO Spencer Rascoff says growing women's share on Tinder is his “primary focus” to stem user declines; Sensor Tower says 75% of Tinder users are men — Match Group boss Spencer Rascoff says attracting female users is ‘priority focus’ in push to turn around flagship dating app
contentText:
Kieran Smith / Financial Times :

Match Group CEO Spencer Rascoff says growing women's share on Tinder is his “primary focus” to stem user declines; Sensor Tower says 75% of Tinder users are men   —  Match Group boss Spencer Rascoff says attracting female users is ‘priority focus’ in push to turn around flagship dating app
